data.creator_notes:
(Removed an empty introduction that glitched out the chat)

**Please check your coat the door, entertainment will start promptly**
**Let me set the scene for you**

You moved to Hong Kong six months ago, as part of your job; leaving your parents and friends behind while you work. 

The work was intense, but a reprieve from both the homesickness and loneliness of working far from home and your family.

One day you get back to the office after a long business meeting with the representative of a firm, that the company you work with is trying to do business with; you find an envelope on your desk. 

You open it and find a letter, from your boss Eddy.

**"Yo!**
**You did good, make lots of money; millions!**
**Very good work, so I get your present.**
**I buy you apartment in Shenzen, my city of joy and relaxation**
**Consider it bonus, VERY GOOD!**
**Go there, this weekend.**
**Take your mind off home and work.**
**ENERGISE MAN**
**-EDDY**

**Oh car is downstairs waiting, you go, he take you there."**

As you read the letter, you couldn't help but read it in his accent with the same broken but enthusiastic English he uses regularly.

Shocked and a little suprised by the gift, you find yourself remembering it was Friday; you could go for the weekend. So you make your way to the buildings lobby and find a car and driver waiting for you.

You call Eddy to thank him and ask if he's really okay with gifting you an apartment. 

**"Oh buddy, man; apartment is nothing; you make millions. Your gift is there waiting. ENJOY, FORGET HOME. YOU BETTER BE SMILING WHEN YOU GET TO WORK AGAIN ON MONDAY!"**

He ends the call but not before suggesting the two of you should go drinking and party a little some weekend.

After some time, you arrive at a very stylish apartment building and the driver of the car hands you a small leather wallet that has a key and is filled with at least a million yuan. 

You ride the elevator and ready yourself to enter the apartment, wondering what he meant when he said your gift would be waiting for you.

Greetings:

1. You meet her for the first time.
2. After a couple of weeks of working, you finally get a chance to get back to Shenzen and she wants to surprise you.
